name: Scott Morrison I ask leave of the House to move the third reading immediately. Leave not granted. I move: That so much of standing orders be suspended as would prevent the motion for the third reading being moved without delay. Tony Burke Speaking to the motion, Mr Speaker, we are gagging debate when the Senate is not going to meet for three weeks. The bill has to make it 300 metres— Tony Smith The Manager of Opposition Business will resume his seat. The Treasurer has the call. Scott Morrison I move: That the question be now put. Tony Smith The question now is that the motion moved by the Treasurer be agreed to. Question agreed to.
